follow-up time: Until completion of the first subsequent pregnancy
study type: multicentre randomised clinical trial with a parallel cohort study
cohort: 255 women with an incomplete evacuation of the uterus after misoprostol treatment
finding: In women with an incomplete miscarriage after misoprostol treatment, curettage and expectant management did not lead to different fertility and pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were similar between women who underwent curettage for incomplete miscarriage after misoprostol treatment and those who underwent expectant management (23% vs 24%, respectively).
